title: AI helper offline coverage audit
mode: diagnostic only; no provider, browser, live paint, or production rebuild used

routing_evidence.offline_ask_priority: Protected-part clarification first; then D.compoundPlan; then eligible E edit plan (unless editYieldsToStack); then advisor; otherwise offlineAskCore, whose order is look request, offlineSpec, offlinePart, offlineElement, offlinePlan.
routing_evidence.setup_fallback: js/spb-pro-ai.js:1671 and :2205 tell unconfigured users to paste an OpenRouter key when no local branch claims the ask.

prior_summary_preserved.meaning: The initial-pass summary is preserved here as a historical baseline. Its conclusion is superseded by the corrected oracle below; cases in this report show the rerun against the current source hash.
prior_summary_preserved.original_conclusion: No fully scoped, complete supported long request was proven to route provider-ward solely because of length.

corrected_scope_audit.fixture_expectation_map: Manual mapping from frozen fixture intent: S01 hood-only; S02 roof-only; S03 whole-car; S04 whole-car plus hood; S05 hood plus roof with other panels excluded; S06 final hood-only; S07 hood-only while roof preserved; S08 whole-car base plus roof layer; U01 animation/true emission capability limit; U02 missing-photo clarification; U03 email/save unsupported; U04 physical moving display clarification.

proven_length_only_offline_plans.judgment: complete for hood-only matte-blue request; no other region is in the executable plan
complete for hood-gold and roof-blue with other panels excluded; executable plan contains only the two requested parts

formerly_misjudged_scope_case.corrected_judgment: full hood-only plan; the fixture asks for hood and compound plan region is hood

partial_or_unsupported_long_candidates.judgment: partial: offlinePart supplies hood snake request but misses required whole-car blue base
partial: offlinePart produces hood red, while the final correction requires matte black
partial: offlinePart produces roof matte black, missing whole-car matte-black base and blue carbon roof layer
unsafe/overbroad candidate: offlinePart includes hood, roof, left side, and right side despite only-there roof scope; offline route is claimed by advisor/edit path, so do not count as complete
unsafe/overbroad candidate: compound plan region includes both hood and roof though roof must stay blue

corrected_scope_audit.conclusion: Corrected oracle proves two genuinely supported long requests (S01-long and S05-long) are sent provider-ward under configured offline-first routing solely because the <=30 compound-plan / generic word gate rejects them, although offlineAskCore has exact executable D.offlinePart plans. This supports a narrow eligibility correction after safety validation: let a fully scoped, instruction-complete offlinePart plan claim supported long asks; do not remove the general length guard based on this evidence.

notes: Initial-pass baseline (now superseded by corrected scope oracle below): 12 offline / 12 provider-ward, with the original conclusion that no fully scoped long request was proven to route provider-ward solely due to length. That conclusion was unsupported because the oracle failed to inspect D.offlinePart plans and inferred hood requests as roof requests.

Separate offline partials: S02-long produces a recommendation targeting the sides for a roof request; S03-long produces an unresolved/partial edit parse and an advisor stripe recommendation for a whole-car base request. Offline eligibility means a local branch claims the prompt, not that its suggested action fully satisfies intent.

Fallback copy opportunity: js/spb-pro-ai.js:1671 and :2205 ask users without configuration to paste an OpenRouter key. Clarify that local paint edits and clarification can work without a key, and mention connecting a key only for image interpretation or broader requests.

Parent-supplied bounded finding (not independently exercised here): js/spb-pro-carmap.js build00 lines 520-522 checks only for window.SpbAI before the default SpbProCar.ensure() labels path calls SpbAI.chat; cached configured:false prevented a network call in the reported audit. ensure(false) avoids that chat call. Review internal offline callers for default ensure() use separately.

Interpretation is diagnostic, not an acceptance gate: this audit runs parsers and actual card application plans against stable helper state; it does not call providers, render a car, or verify live app routing beyond the extracted offline gate and inspected ask gate.

cases.ask: Paint only the hood matte blue.
For my next track day, please paint only the hood matte blue. Leave every other panel exactly as it is because I already like the current body color and do not want the rest changed.
Make the roof pearl gold with fine hex cells only there.

advisorAnswer.text:
A layered look: 3 layers in one zone on the roof:
- **Base**: CF: Champagne Frost [brightness -24] — Pale champagne gold and cream pearl flake, bright and soft like frosted celebration paint. (high gloss, high metal); brightness -24 toward gold
- **Pattern**: Hex Mesh — paint pattern on top: Dense fine honeycomb mesh with bright glowing cell edges, high contrast, tightly packed… — x0.42 size, 65% strength; pairs with matte black, gunmetal
- **Shine**: Pearl Micro — shine texture (colours stay): Smooth undulating mother-of-pearl iridescence, soft micro sparkle, no anisotropy; gentle… — x1 size, 70% strength; pairs with gloss, metallic
Size: Hex Mesh at "fine" = x0.42 (0.6 of its normal x0.7).
2 alternative stacks below. **Use this kit** puts every layer on the roof in one step (one Undo); nothing changes until you press it.

cases.ask: For the next version of this design, make the roof pearl gold with fine hex cells only there. Keep the hood, doors, and every other painted surface as they currently are.

advisorAnswer.text: For the sides: a few directions that work on an existing scheme. Your body is Gloss (high gloss). I searched the whole catalogue and picked shine-only options that keep your paint, complete looks whose palette suits your colours. Swatches are shown on gold.

cases.ask: Set the whole car to silver.
For a clean new look before the weekend, set the whole car to silver. Please apply the same silver base across every painted body panel and do not add any stripes or patterns.

advisorAnswer.text:
Here are 3 finish kits for your whole car (body + stripes). In each kit the accents have a different shine from the body, the numbers stay plain, and no finish is used twice across the kits. A texture only changes the shine pattern: your colours stay. **Use this kit** applies the whole kit in one step (one Undo).
- **Classic**: Body Wet Look, Stripes Satin. Proven finishes: calm, clean and easy to read.
- **Premium**: Body Pearl, Stripes Brushed, Texture (hood) Carbon 2×2 Twill. Richer materials: pearl, metal and candy depth, still tasteful, plus a fine shine texture on the hood.
- **Bold**: Body Metallic, Stripes Anodized, Hood (hero) Chameleon Fire, Texture (roof) Liquid Metal. A statement: stronger finishes, a complete-look hero panel on the hood and a texture on the roof.
